{{Top|leg}}
The '''Contruum Shipyard''' was a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] in orbit around the [[planet]] of [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum.]]<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==Description==
A mid-sized yard consisting of a collection of interconnected spherical modules and multiple docks, it was nonetheless able to produce craft up to [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] in size, and was considered a modest franchise.<ref name="TUF" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the shipyard was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and [[Hylo Sortuli]] stole the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Shadow Raptor|''Eccentric Lad'']] there during the [[Contruum rebellion]].<ref name="DitW">{{FFG|story=Dead in the Water|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Game Master's Kit|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Game Master's Kit}}</ref>

The Contruum Shipyard later produced [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance]] fleet designs, including sleek destroyers with names that embodied virtues like ''Temperance'', ''Prudence'', and ''Equity''.<ref name="TUF" />
